method: Criterion-level exclusion-role delta on previously completed v0.8.0 source-first adjudication, preserving all evidence holds and canonical source-clause dispositions; no full source search performed.

outcomes.title: German television personality alleged deepfake pornography was distributed using her likeness
outcomes.criterion_screen: The preserved deepfake depictions are person-bound, but authorship, generator request and consent/access-to-likeness authority remain unresolved. No generator-side FC-053 Not aligned condition is established from downstream circulation, and the inability to reconstruct a source path in this review is not itself evidence of an occurrence-level synthesis-traceability failure. V0.8.1 class-scope identity-representation exclusions require proof of an absence of attributable person-bound transformation, which is not supported here; the missing decisive conditions still preclude an admitted role. The record remains unclassified with E001 unresolved and partial listed-clause coverage.
outcomes.scope: Bounded v0.8.1 exclusion-role patch check; no fresh source retrieval, no material new assertion of success/failure, no independently human-certified analysis.

outcomes.title: Yale student challenged discipline allegedly influenced by GPTZero
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-046 Boundary remains materially engaged by a detector-assisted investigation followed by distinct academic sanctions, while the actual dispositive evidentiary weight of the detector and asserted independent reasons are contested. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusion for inference that is inaccurate or biased but not promoted into consequential authority cannot be assumed when an inquiry was in fact initiated and two consequential decision paths followed; equally, no unsupported automatic algorithmic sanction may be inferred. The reported independent evidence for later decisions is counterevidence and leaves the precisely bounded authority-conversion question unresolved.
outcomes.scope: Bounded v0.8.1 exclusion-role patch check; no fresh source retrieval, no material new assertion of success/failure, no independently human-certified analysis.

outcomes.title: Spokane city distributed an AI-generated flyer without required disclosure
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-038 Not aligned is independently supported because an applicable municipal AI-disclosure requirement was not activated before the public flyer was distributed, rather than merely an ineffective already active control. FC-080 Boundary has several distinctive one-to-one features matching a particular artist's antecedent sticker, which materially engages the human-contribution relationship, while the actual model source-to-output incorporation and credit arrangement remain unknown. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusion for mere incidental inspiration is not affirmatively established by the available distinctive similarity; neither is material incorporation proven. The city withdrawal and apology are subsequent actions, not a revision of the original failures.
outcomes.scope: Bounded v0.8.1 exclusion-role patch check; no fresh source retrieval, no material new assertion of success/failure, no independently human-certified analysis.
